t: Strapi Enterprise Edition Pricing Update
s: Most of our competitors use lots of different variables (entries, content types, locales, users, API calls, storage, etc.) as part of their pricing. Some of these metrics, like API calls and storage, are less relevant for us since Strapi is self-hosted while the number of content entries doesn't necessarily reflect the criticality of their project.
